questions.promptVi: [Đọc hiểu đoạn văn 1] Đọc đoạn hội thoại mở đầu sau và trả lời câu hỏi:
questions.passage:
Brandon (Nam): "Good morning, Clara! I heard you took up digital illustration recently."
Clara (Nữ): "Yes! I take after my mother, who is a passionate watercolor landscape painter."
Brandon (Nam): "Whenever you encounter complex graphic design terms, do you look them up online?"
Clara (Nữ): "Always! I look up technical tutorials, but I also look for creative inspiration in nature."
